answer_1.quote: End-to-end (E2E) dialog retrieval models jointly encode a dialog and a candidate response ... The goal of this paper is to set a new direction for future task-oriented dialog system research: while retrieving the best candidate is crucial, it should be equally important to identify when the correct response (i.e. ground truth) is not present in the candidate set.
